courses.title: APPLIED FINANCIAL MATHEMATICS
courses.prereqText: At least 0.50 course from: Mathematics 1225A/B, Mathematics 1230A/B, Calculus 1000A/B, Calculus 1500A/B. Must be registered in a module offered by King’s University College.

courses.title: MATHEMATICS FOR FINANCIAL ANALYSIS
courses.prereqText: 1.0 course or two 0.5 courses at the 1000 level or higher from Applied Mathematics, Calculus, Mathematics, or Numerical and Mathematical Methods.

courses.title: LONG TERM ACTUARIAL MATHEMATICS I
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in each of Actuarial Science 2553A/B, either Calculus 2402A/B or the former Calculus 2502A/B, and Statistical Sciences 2857A/B.

courses.title: MATHEMATICS OF FINANCE
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in one of Calculus 1501A/B, Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1414A/B, the former Applied Mathematics 1414A/B, the former Applied Mathematics 1413, or a minimum mark of 85% in Calculus 1301A/B. Integrated Science 1001X with a minimum mark of 60% can be used in place of Calculus 1301A/B.

courses.title: SHORT TERM ACTUARIAL MATHEMATICS I (LOSS MODELS)
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Statistical Sciences 3657A/B. Restricted to students enrolled in any Actuarial Science module, or those registered in the Honours Specialization module in Statistics, the Major in Financial Modelling, or the Honours Specialization in Financial Modelling module.

courses.title: LONG TERM ACTUARIAL MATHEMATICS II
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in each of Actuarial Science 2427A/B and Statistical Sciences 2858A/B.

courses.title: LONG TERM ACTUARIAL MATHEMATICS III
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in each of Actuarial Science 3429A/B and in Statistical Sciences 3657A/B. Restricted to students enrolled in any Actuarial Science module.

courses.title: ACTUARIAL PRACTICE I
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Actuarial Science 2427A/B. Restricted to students who have completed all courses specifically mentioned in the Major in Actuarial Science module.

courses.title: SURVIVAL ANALYSIS
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Statistical Sciences 3858A/B.

courses.title: SHORT TERM ACTUARIAL MATHEMATICS II
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Statistical Sciences 3858A/B. Restricted to students enroled in any Actuarial Science module, or those registered in the Honours Specialization module in Statistics or the Honours Specialization in Financial Modelling module.

courses.title: SELECTED TOPICS IN ACTUARIAL SCIENCE
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Actuarial Science 2427A/B and permission of the department.

courses.title: SELECTED TOPICS IN ACTUARIAL SCIENCE
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Actuarial Science 2427A/B and permission of the department.

courses.title: PROJECT IN ACTUARIAL SCIENCE
courses.prereqText: Registration in the fourth year of the Honours Specialization in Actuarial Science, Statistics, or Financial Modelling. Students must have a modular course average of at least 80% and must find a faculty member to supervise the project.
courses.antireqText: Data Science 4999Z, Financial Modelling 4998F/G/Z, Statistical Sciences 4999F/G/Z.
